intended_use.summary: Source eligibility for at most one fixed-order free HyP3 Basic RTC_GAMMA job per approved S1D scene, followed by non-Git receipt and local product identity and integrity inspection. This gate does not release execution before separate implementation, public CI, current free-credit, and no-content gates; it does not accept product pixels for map use or authorize redistribution.

sources.name: ASF HyP3 Basic on-demand RTC_GAMMA for four approved Sentinel-1D GRDs

evidence.note: Hash-bound exact GRD names, one-scene job definitions, method settings, and event-first order.

criteria.note: This identifies the service request and source cohort. Actual generated products will need independent identity checks.

evidence.note: Official ASF full-scene RTC_GAMMA product guide describes exact processing options and product package.

criteria.note: ASF operates this Basic service and documents its RTC method.

evidence.note: Official Basic guidance permits Earthdata users to request no-payment On Demand products, with monthly free credits and 14-day output retention.
Owner-controlled Basic account check reported at least 240 free credits, and all four exact definitions passed authenticated validation at at most 60 credits each.

criteria.note: Access and exact-job eligibility passed at validation time. A fresh free Basic credit check is mandatory immediately before processing; no paid path is allowed.

evidence.note: ASF expressly offers users free Basic On Demand product requests and downloads for 14 days.
ASF provides product-specific acknowledgement and DOI instructions, supporting intended local research inspection while reserving publication conditions.
Owner reported accepting the agreement presented at sign-in and public visibility of jobs and outputs.
Owner expressly declined retrieving the exact agreement document for continuation. This does not waive restrictions or authorize the agent to accept terms.

criteria.note: Pass is narrow: request free Basic processing and inspect the resulting product locally under the user's reported accepted access. No claim is made about the unavailable exact agreement text, output redistribution, product-specific DEM license, map export, or scientific publication. Stop if a changed or conflicting term is presented; inspect actual README before downstream use.

evidence.note: Code hash-binds candidate, proposal, bundle, approval, exact source order and RTC settings.

criteria.note: Persist exact submission and provider job identity; later product README and log must bind inputs, ASF method, DEM, and product.

evidence.note: Generated-data-tested plan verifies file size and SHA-256, ZIP safety and CRC, exact members, and no-replace custody before pixel use.

criteria.note: This is a post-acquisition verification plan, not a claim that any provider bytes exist or passed.

evidence.note: Approved catalog footprints fit an attempt to establish two-date event-AOI raster coverage, not actual valid pixels.
Live Basic API accepted exact definitions and quoted no more than 60 credits for each.

criteria.note: Fit is limited to trying the exact job and assessing product integrity. Real AOI pixels, masks, registration, and map fitness remain untested.

evidence.note: Owner accepted public job metadata and outputs.
Owner-controlled secret-safe handoff passed synthetic tests and a real four-source validation without credentials in receipts.
ASF warns all submitted jobs, user IDs and generated downloads are public; names must omit sensitive information.

criteria.note: A future processing worker must pass its own secret-exposure and interruption tests. Public job names are fixed non-sensitive source IDs; files and account identifiers stay outside Git.

claim_boundary: This source assessment resolves only the narrowly intended free Basic generation and local inspection path under existing owner authority. It is neither execution release nor a product license, product identity, pixel-QA pass, map-use pass, derived-pixel publication, M3/M4 result, or scientific claim.
